versions.changelog:
Initial release of image-ppt skill.

- Provides a 3-step workflow to convert books, PDFs, or text materials into editable, high-quality PPT presentations.
- Platform-agnostic methodology using three core prompt templates for content summarization, design, image-based PPT generation, and editable PPT reconstruction.
- Step-by-step guide supports various AI assistants (Codex + GPT-Image 2.0 recommended) for flexible execution.
- Includes clear adaptation suggestions for different AI platforms and tools.
- Suitable for class reports, book sharing, meetings, project presentations, and competitions.
- Core prompts provided in references/prompts.md for modular use.
